TITLE: Board View & Tech View – Clicking Outside the Clear-Shifts Question Doesn't Cancel the Move
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10047 (Ready for QA, read 9 Oct 2026) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10047 · LABEL: board-tech-view

h2. Description

Closing the *"Clear …'s scheduled shifts?"* question in any way should *call the change off* and put the card back.

For example,
* a work order is dragged to another technician and the question opens
* *Cancel*, the *X* and *Escape* all call the move off correctly
* a click outside the question does nothing: the question stays open

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* and the *PRD* (S4-R30).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Pick a work order whose lead technician has a shift on it for the whole work order tomorrow (e.g. 8:00–12:00).
# In *Work Orders* > *Board View*, drag its card into another technician's column.
#* The question *Clear …'s scheduled shifts?* opens.
# Click an empty part of the page outside the question.
#* The question stays open and the card stays in the new column.
# Do the same in *Tech View*: drag the row into another technician's group, then click outside the question.
#* The same happens: the question stays open and the row stays in the new group.

*Actual Result:*
* In Board View and in Tech View, a click outside the question does not close it; only Cancel, X or Escape call the move off.

*Expected Result:*
* Closing the question by clicking outside calls the move off: the card goes back to its place.

h2. Sources

{quote}Cancel, or closing the prompt, calls the change off. A dragged card goes back to where it was; in the Reassign dialog the user is back in the dialog with their choice kept.{quote}
